proceedings.supporting_quote: On 5 April 1995 at about 8.30 p.m. the applicant, driving a car, was arrested in Slovenj Gradec by officers of the Special Unit and the Slovenj Gradec Police.
On 6 April 1995, soon after his release, the applicant was admitted to the Slovenj Gradec General Hospital
On 7 April 1995 the applicant went to the Slovenj Gradec Police and made an oral complaint against the officers of the Special Unit concerning the events of 5 April 1995.
Next day, 7 April 1995, the applicant sought medical aid in the Maribor General Hospital.
On 17 January 1997 the Public Prosecutor issued a decision dismissing the applicant’s criminal complaint.
On 8 May 1997... the Slovenj Gradec District Court decided not to open a criminal investigation against the applicant
On 12 May 1997 the Public Prosecutor appealed against this decision. On 4 December 1997 the Maribor Higher Court upheld her appeal
parties: Slovenj Gradec District Public Prosecutor’s Office (initiating)

proceedings.supporting_quote: On 17 March 1998 the criminal investigation was concluded
His objection was rejected by the Slovenj Gradec District Court on 16 February 1999.
By a judgment of 22 November 1999 the court acquitted the applicant.
parties: Slovenj Gradec District Public Prosecutor’s Office (initiating)

proceedings.supporting_quote: On 5 January 2000 the Public Prosecutor appealed against the judgment and on 27 September 2000 the Maribor Higher Court quashed the judgment and remitted the case to a new panel for retrial.
parties: Slovenj Gradec District Public Prosecutor’s Office (initiating)

proceedings.supporting_quote: The judgment of 12 February 2001 issued in the proceedings instituted against the applicant
By a judgment of 12 February 2001, the Slovenj Gradec District Court convicted the applicant as charged
parties: Slovenj Gradec District Public Prosecutor’s Office (initiating)

proceedings.supporting_quote: On 9 May 2001 the Maribor Higher Court upheld the conviction
parties: Slovenj Gradec District Public Prosecutor’s Office (initiating)

proceedings.supporting_quote: on 11 October 2001 the Slovenj Gradec District Court ordered the applicant to pay an additional sum to cover the costs of one of the witnesses heard during the proceedings. On that day, the proceedings were “finally concluded”
